summary: Pydantic 1.10.9 → 2.14.1 is a major breaking-change upgrade. Almost every public API on BaseModel has been renamed (dict→model_dump, json→model_dump_json, parse_obj→model_validate, copy→model_copy, etc.), the validator decorators changed (@validator→@field_validator, @root_validator→@model_validator), model configuration moved from an inner class Config to a model_config dict, GenericModel was removed, and numerous Field() keyword arguments were renamed or removed. Python 3.8 and 3.9 are no longer supported. The automated migration tool `bump-pydantic` can handle many of these changes mechanically.

rules.why: BaseModel.dict() is removed in V2; use model_dump() instead.
BaseModel.json() is removed in V2; use model_dump_json() instead.
parse_obj() is removed in V2; use model_validate() instead.
parse_raw() is removed in V2; use model_validate_json() instead.
parse_file() is removed in V2; load the file manually and pass to model_validate().
BaseModel.copy() is removed in V2; use model_copy() instead.
construct() is removed in V2; use model_construct() instead.
schema() is removed in V2; use model_json_schema() instead.
update_forward_refs() is removed in V2; use model_rebuild() instead.
from_orm() is removed in V2; use model_validate() with from_attributes=True config.
__fields__ is removed in V2; use model_fields instead.
Inner Config class is deprecated in V2; use model_config = ConfigDict(...) instead.
Config key allow_population_by_field_name was renamed to populate_by_name.
Config key orm_mode was renamed to from_attributes.
Config key schema_extra was renamed to json_schema_extra.
Config key validate_all was renamed to validate_default.
Config key allow_mutation has been removed; use frozen=True (inverted meaning) instead.
Config key anystr_lower was renamed to str_to_lower.
Config key max_anystr_length was renamed to str_max_length.
Config key min_anystr_length was renamed to str_min_length.
@validator is deprecated in V2; replace with @field_validator from pydantic.
@root_validator is deprecated in V2; replace with @model_validator.
@validate_arguments has been renamed to @validate_call in V2.

rules.old:
from pydantic.generics import GenericModel
class MyModel(GenericModel, Generic[T]): ...
rules.new:
from pydantic import BaseModel
class MyModel(BaseModel, Generic[T]): ...
rules.why: pydantic.generics.GenericModel has been removed; inherit from BaseModel with Generic[T] directly.

rules.new:
from pydantic import RootModel
class MyModel(RootModel[list[str]]): ...
rules.why: The __root__ field pattern has been replaced with the RootModel class in V2.
Field(regex=...) has been renamed to Field(pattern=...) in V2.
Field(min_items=...) has been renamed to Field(min_length=...) in V2.
Field(max_items=...) has been renamed to Field(max_length=...) in V2.
Field(allow_mutation=...) has been replaced by Field(frozen=...) in V2.

rules.new: Use typing.Final or Literal[value] as the type annotation instead
rules.why: Field(const=True) has been removed in V2; use typing.Final or Literal type annotations.
Field constraints are no longer pushed down to generic parameters; use Annotated on the inner type.
The always=True argument to @validator is replaced by validate_default=True on Field() in V2.
root_validator(skip_on_failure=False) is no longer supported; use @model_validator(mode='before') instead.

rules.old:
class Config:
    json_encoders = {datetime: lambda v: v.isoformat()}
rules.why: json_encoders config is deprecated in V2; use @field_serializer or @model_serializer decorators instead.
Pydantic dataclasses no longer have __pydantic_model__; wrap the dataclass with TypeAdapter instead.

rules.new:
from pydantic import TypeAdapter
from pydantic.networks import EmailStr
TypeAdapter(EmailStr).validate_python('user@example.com')
rules.why: pydantic.validate_email() utility function was removed; validate using EmailStr with TypeAdapter.
